building.title: Still Here
building.tagline: A habit app for cutting back on smoking.
building.body:
I'm building Still Here for myself first. I smoke, and I'm cutting back.

Most habit apps reset you to zero the second you slip, which is a machine for feeling like a failure. This one keeps every good day you've earned, forgives the ones you don't, and never shows a red mark. Every honest day plants something on your own little pixel island. It's free, with no ads.

building.title: SANTAI
building.tagline: Memorabilia for my love of vintage and quirky T-shirts.
building.body:
SANTAI is where my passion for vintage and quirky tees lives. It's my memorabilia, and a home for one exclusive shirt released each season.

I designed and built the whole site myself: a full-screen shirt you can drag to rotate, and a CMS so a new drop never needs a code editor.
